title: [cross-repo] Add single-owner protected v1 admission genesis workflow
observed: From FS.GG.Coordination: the OperatingV1 fleet authority is live but the canonical production v1 admission operation journal is absent. A dedicated, review-gated authorization receipt is required before its one-time genesis; the pinned GS2-08.2 cutover workflow cannot change bytes.
rootCause: The accepted v1 admission implementation is deliberately fail-closed without a protected operation scope and has no separate native human-approval channel for the missing journal's genesis.
acceptance: Add a separate workflow_dispatch workflow bound to the dedicated fleet-v1-admission-owner environment under ADR-0087: sole accountable-owner approval, self-review permitted after a five-minute wait, and main-only branch policy. Validate exact source revision, genesis intent SHA-256, and bounded operation identity; emit a short-lived receipt containing run, source, workflow revision, intent, and expiry. Pin third-party actions. Keep the existing fleet-cutover environment and cutover authorization workflow unchanged. Add negative controls for unreviewed or altered invocation and exact receipt shape.
verification: Run the dedicated workflow quality test; independently reread the workflow bytes and a reviewed Actions run before any signature or Authority ref creation. Coordination's protected installer must reject wrong workflow, reviewer, run, digest, or expiry.
